upstream_model.bridge_rule: Identical material IDs represent the same boundary pool. Copy producer relations from the first file only when constructing a combined graph.

semantics.relationship_to_first_file: Append this manufacturing layer by merging identical upstream boundary material IDs; leave the first extraction file unchanged.
semantics.grade_boundaries: An upstream candidate never becomes qualified merely because it is linked. Assay/accept nodes reject inadequate material; they do not invent refining.
semantics.recipe_logic: All listed input ports and installed equipment/working inventories are required within a selected recipe. Alternative producers and qualified import substitutions are OR supply choices.
semantics.quantities: Unknown is null, not zero. Do not solve capacities, cost, import fraction or resource demand until recipes, counts, yields and specifications are instantiated.
semantics.physical_units: Bulk streams use kg; components/equipment use unit/set/wafer; digital designs use a versioned package. kg_per_kg_main_feed is retained for schema compatibility and null where inapplicable.
semantics.configuration: Family nodes are templates, not fully fungible stock. Instantiate grades, drawings, revisions, batch identities and BOM roles before allocating them to a target assembly.
semantics.chemical_equations: Only selected ideal species templates are provided. They are not whole-feed balances, recovery guarantees or industrial operating instructions.
semantics.auxiliaries: Catalysts, membranes, masks, gases, adhesives and standards need initial charge, makeup and replacement. Working inventory does not mean unlimited or lossless.
semantics.equipment: Generation-0 qualified seed tools are an installed capability requirement; their controls and precision parts may initially come from Earth.
semantics.generation_separation: Manufactured equipment/power/factory seeds become available in a later generation. Their manufacturing recipes never depend on their own future output.
semantics.cycles: Recycling, catalyst regeneration, maintenance and industrial growth are physically cyclic; this is a single-pass, generation-separated DAG. Connect later batches only in a time-expanded scheduler.
semantics.energy: Manufacturing draws on generation-0 power and heat rejection. A newly manufactured array is not free energy for producing itself.
semantics.digital_design: Software, circuit layouts, PDKs and drawings carry versioned information and validation dependencies. They are not consumed kilograms or freely inferred from silicon.
semantics.product_families: Named examples are design-selected candidates, not universal recipes for every semiconductor, robot, medicine or spacecraft.
semantics.medicine: Synthesis/expression is distinct from pharmaceutical release. All medicinal outputs remain unqualified; no clinical use, dose or release authorisation is provided.
semantics.speculation: Collector swarms and beamed interstellar propulsion are conceptual architectures. A rigid stellar shell is not offered as a physically supported manufacturing target.
semantics.aerospace_grade: Material identity or terrestrial production does not confer flight, radiation, pressure-vessel or mission qualification.
semantics.coverage: A broad baseline dependency catalogue, not a complete industrial civilisation, flight design, factory BOM, pharmaceutical protocol or semiconductor process design kit.
semantics.footprint_queries: Product dependency unions preserve discoverability. They over-approximate optional routes and must not be read as minimal mandatory Earth-import lists.
semantics.audited_architectures: Selected examples now name an n-well CMOS scheme, explicit PV post-diffusion states, pump/thermal hardware and wheel/thruster GNC. These are candidate configurations, not universal designs.
semantics.residuals: Generic residual nodes are segregated bookkeeping placeholders; never transport or recycle them as one physically mixed stream.
semantics.reference_conditions: Literature temperatures/times describe only the specified experiment; operating_conditions remain null for the proposed plant.

bootstrap.promotion_rule: After completed manufacture, commissioning and qualification, the scheduler may instantiate the corresponding installed asset at t+1. Do not add a current-generation feedback edge.

facility_segregation_rules: Keep excavation dust, foundry vapour and fiber handling out of semiconductor, optical and pharmaceutical environments.
Do not share fluid/gas distribution across purity classes without specified cleaning, compatibility and qualification.
Battery abuse tests, propulsion hot fire, high-power beams and chemical waste handling require suitable containment and standoff.
Facilities can share engineered utilities only when capacity, contamination and pressure/thermal interfaces are explicitly closed.

procedure_audit.scope: Literature/engineering desk review of all original records and added corrections; not experimental verification.

corrected_dependency_contracts.correction: Selected glucose-based reference; added activation equipment, aqueous supply, separate residue streams and distinct PVDF/NMP versus CMC/SBR/water binder systems. Conductive carbon needs its own acceptance specification.
Added cell enclosure/tab/seal set, thermal interface/cold plate, and an explicit imported-BMS assembly alternative.
Separated CZ master charge from implant gases; selected a single-n-well illustration and added a pre-gate surface-clean state. The unspecified isolation module remains blocked.
Inserted dopant-glass removal and a visible edge-isolation design gate before passivation.
Added pump motor/drive, coolant pipework/power interface and a separate bearing-steel supply route.
Named reaction wheels, external-torque thrusters, star tracker/IMU and array actuator/sensing for the chosen architecture instead of assuming generic actuators supply every function.
Distinguished catalytic acid charge from stoichiometric consumption; generic residue ports are explicitly segregated bookkeeping, not a physical mixed waste stream.

qualification.finding: Assay/test can accept or reject suitable feed. It does not supply missing refining or material hardening.

chemicals.finding: Selected synthesis chemistry is plausible; purification, catalyst/medium selection and complete recycle/duty balances are not closed.

polymers.finding: Monomer/formulation-specific polymer operations are supported families; grades, solvent recovery and space compatibility need qualification.

metals.finding: Metallurgy and forming are credible process families. Selected alloy grade, phase history, cleanliness and properties must be demonstrated.

ceramics.finding: Phase synthesis is distinct from powder preparation, densification and precision/component qualification.

composites.finding: Fiber/laminate production requires the selected precursor, sizing, resin and cure; elemental carbon alone does not establish a composite.

semiconductors.finding: Individual operations are credible. The selected generic controller flow remains incomplete without a PDK, full layer sequence, actual masks, limits and test program.

electronics.finding: Supplied/local component assemblies need complete circuit/BOM, calibrated tests and environmental/radiation evidence. Generic component names are not interchangeable designs.

PV.finding: Cell fabrication and CIC/array assembly are credible. Dopant-glass removal and isolation are explicit; mission radiation and deployment performance remain unvalidated.

battery.finding: The selected Fe/P/Li cathode route has laboratory support. Binder, conductive carbon, separator, enclosure and pack hardware are separately specified. Finished-cell/pack performance is not inherited.

thermal.finding: Working fluid, motor/pipework and phase handling must match the operating range. Radiator area needs a net radiation/absorption balance.

optics.finding: Reflective membrane, precision mirror and laser-damage-resistant optic require different geometry, coatings and qualification.

robotics.finding: Explicit motors, drives, bearings, gearing and sensors are necessary but do not establish load capacity, autonomy or lifetime.

space_systems.finding: Defined subassemblies improve dependencies, but propulsion/GNC/thermal/orbit/structural integration and commissioning remain design-specific.

industrial_expansion.finding: Next-generation tools retain imported precision/control parts. Their successful manufacture and qualification must precede use as later-generation capacity.

medicines.finding: The ASA reaction is chemistry support only; a clinically usable pharmaceutical needs product-specific process, analytical and release validation.

biomanufacturing.finding: Specified strain/product expression and purification research does not establish a general medicine factory or validated release.

megascale.finding: Subsystem production is not proof of a practical collector swarm or interstellar beam system. Orbital, thermal, optical and control feasibility remains unresolved.

tooling.finding: WC/Co phase preparation, sintering and tool finishing need chosen powder grades and geometry; cutting-tool performance is not a formula consequence.

lubricants.finding: FT/upgrading can make base-oil families; additive formulation and vacuum lubrication are separate qualification problems.

key_remaining_limits: Most process records remain design-selected templates, not executable industrial recipes.
No whole-ore/component species balance, numerical yield, purity, energy or equipment duty is validated.
Acyclicity and atom balance are structural checks, not evidence of kinetics, equilibrium or engineering performance.
Installed tools, designs, calibration, speciality stock and biological seed/reference systems remain dependencies.
Medicines, spacecraft and megascale systems require product/mission-specific designs and qualification.
